summary: Masterchef-style staking pool for a single ERC1155 token ID. Stakers deposit `stakedId` units, earn per-second phUSD emissions. Emission rate R is derived from owner-set targetAPY sized against the STAKED-SUBSET notional S = totalStaked * latestPrice (post-audit M-03), funded by pull()-ing realised mint-debt from the dispatcher hook plus owner top-ups. Runway (windowEnd) is derived = budget/R.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoopsNote: No loops anywhere; all accounting is O(1) masterchef per-share math.
verifiedProperties.checkedArithmeticNote: 0.8.20, no unchecked/assembly. Bare multiplies (totalStaked*latestPrice, elapsed*rewardRate, user.amount*acc) are documented-bounded and revert on overflow. mulDiv used for latestPrice and F.
verifiedProperties.reentrancyGuardedNote: All user state-changing entrypoints are nonReentrant (OZ ReentrancyGuard). ERC1155 inbound transfers land on this contract (ERC1155Holder); outbound unstake transfer invokes onERC1155Received on msg.sender but is guarded.
verifiedProperties.accessControlNote: All setters/funding are onlyOwner; pause/unpause are onlyPauser. stake/unstake/claim are whenNotPaused; emergencyWithdraw is callable while paused.

localFindingsNote: No standalone single-contract local findings surfaced. The contract is heavily hardened by audit fixes M-01 (committedDebt solvency ledger) and M-03 (staked-subset rate sizing). Cross-contract / economic concerns (hook trust, mint-debt accuracy, runway dynamics) are deferred to interaction/econ analysis per scope rules.

externalEntryPoints.notes: Head _syncBudget settles accrual at OLD rate/OLD totalStaked; tail _recomputeSchedule re-sizes R against post-mutation totalStaked (M-03).

valueFlows: OUT: ERC1155 stakedId units + pending phUSD
externalEntryPoints.notes: Tail _recomputeSchedule re-sizes R down for the smaller pool.

valueFlows: OUT: full ERC1155 principal; FORFEITS pending phUSD
externalEntryPoints.notes: ESCAPE HATCH: callable while paused, does NOT call _syncBudget/_updatePool (so a broken hook/minter/recompute can never trap principal). Forfeited pending moves committedDebt->rewardBudget to preserve solvency invariant.
Settles accrual at OLD rate before mutation. newAPY==0 supported (policy pause).
No empty-pool guard (hook rotation is a live operation).
Read-only; totalBudget/runwaySeconds read live mintDebt from hook.

externalCalls.notes: pull() mints phUSD to this contract (must be the hook's configured recipient). mintDebt() feeds V in recompute. A reverting/misbehaving hook cannot trap principal (emergencyWithdraw bypasses it) and recompute clamps budget at 0 if V<committedDebt.

Supplies price + growthBasisPoints driving latestPrice. price==0 -> rate 0 (safe). totalSupply(id) declared on the interface but NOT used by current code (rate is sized on totalStaked, not totalSupply, post-M-03).
Solvency invariant assumes balance accounting is exact (no fee-on-transfer / rebasing).
Inbound to this (ERC1155Holder); outbound to msg.sender triggers onERC1155Received (guarded by nonReentrant).

localInvariantCandidates: SOLVENCY (strong): rewardToken.balanceOf(this) == rewardBudget + committedDebt at all times (the central M-01 invariant). _updatePool moves rewardBudget->committedDebt; _safePay decrements both balance and (committedDebt then rewardBudget) by the paid amount; _recomputeSchedule resets rewardBudget = V - committedDebt; topUp raises balance and rewardBudget equally; emergencyWithdraw moves forfeited pending committedDebt->rewardBudget; pull() swaps mintDebt->balance 1:1 (invariant-neutral).
NO-OVERPAY: contract never transfers more phUSD than balance; _safePay reverts on shortfall rather than silently capping.

RATE-FORMULA: after every _recomputeSchedule, rewardRate == (S * targetAPY / APY_PRECISION) / SECONDS_PER_YEAR with S = totalStaked * latestPrice; latestPrice = price/r (r=1+growthBasisPoints*1e14/1e18), or price if growthBasisPoints==0, or 0 if price==0.
RUNWAY: after every recompute, windowEnd == block.timestamp + budget/rewardRate (floor); == block.timestamp when rewardRate==0.

APY-AS-FLOOR (M-03): per-NFT emission == latestPrice*targetAPY/Y; the latest minter earns exactly targetAPY, earlier minters >= targetAPY; NO N/totalStaked participation multiplier (lone staker does not earn N*APY).
NO-RETROACTIVE: accRewardPerShare advances only over (lastRewardTime, min(now, windowEnd)] at the current rate; new staker rewardDebt pins to current acc.
CLEAN-DEPLETION: _updatePool clamps reward to remaining rewardBudget; emissions stop at windowEnd.
TOTALSTAKED-CONSISTENCY: totalStaked == sum over users of users[a].amount.
RECONFIG-LOCK: setDispatcherIndex / setNFTMinter / setStakedId revert unless totalStaked == 0.
APY-BOUND: targetAPY <= MAX_TARGET_APY (0.5e18) always (enforced in setTargetAPY).
PRINCIPAL-NEVER-TRAPPED: emergencyWithdraw always returns full user.amount of stakedId regardless of hook/minter/recompute health (no _syncBudget/_updatePool), callable while paused.

RATE-CADENCE-INDEPENDENCE: with unchanged totalStaked, latestPrice, targetAPY, repeated pullAndRefresh()/topUp(small) leave rewardRate unchanged (rate depends only on on-chain state, not inflow size/cadence).
trustAssumptions: dispatcherHook is the owner-configured BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook with this contract as recipient; pull() mints phUSD here; mintDebt() is honest. (OOS — interaction analysis owns hook-trust exploitability.)
nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) returns honest price/growthBasisPoints; price manipulation feeds rate/runway. (OOS sibling.)
rewardToken (phUSD) and stakedToken behave as standard ERC20/ERC1155 (no fee-on-transfer / rebasing / reentrant hooks beyond the guarded ERC1155 callback).
Owner is non-malicious (Law 3); owner can pause emissions via targetAPY=0, top up, rotate hook, and reconfigure only on an empty pool.
pauser address is the trusted global Pauser.
noteOnDesignDoc: docs/design.md is partially STALE relative to code: it describes the older fixed-window model (windowDuration / DEFAULT_WINDOW 540d / setWindowDuration / MIN_WINDOW / MAX_WINDOW) and the 4-field Pulled event. The shipped code uses the variable-runway APY-target model (no windowDuration; windowEnd derived = now + budget/R) per CLAUDE.md and docs/runway-dynamics-and-apy-as-policy.md, which are the authoritative specs. Treat CLAUDE.md's 'Critical Invariants' section as the source of truth.
